definitions.routing: actual action-token top-4 overlap over 8 HB layers x 10 denoise x 10 action tokens
definitions.primary_candidate: task equal-prefix q99 loop score and positive X/R/A return topology
definitions.outcome_role: external validation only after discovery and clustering

limitations: qpos is not a stored RGB or vision embedding
event discovery uses the next query and is not an early warning test
clusters are geometric and have no semantic failure-cause labels
full-trajectory cluster outcomes are length and terminal-phase confounded
outcome association is not a causal routing intervention
